plugins.name: oryxflow
plugins.description: Trustworthy, reproducible AI data analysis in Claude Code. oryxflow is a data-science plugin that stops your coding agent building on stale data - it reruns exactly what your code, data, or parameters change, verifies the rerun happened, and records what produced every result. Finished work is reused, so the guarantee costs you less time, not more.

commands.name: check-standards
commands.description: Check oryxflow project code against the house standards for readable, reliable code - naming (task / column / variable / module), code style (ASCII-only, self.logger, no try/except, off-the-shelf libraries), task-vs-utils placement, and docstring contracts. Evaluates and recommends a concrete fix per issue; applies only what the user approves. Use before or after writing a task.

commands.name: init-project
commands.description: Scaffold a new oryxflow project into the current directory from the bundled minimal template (skip-existing, never overwrite).
headings: 1. Pre-flight - do not clobber an existing project

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Restructure a messy data-science project (monolithic notebooks / scripts with hardcoded paths and linear function chains) into a scalable oryxflow pipeline - decompose the implicit steps into output-named, parameterized, cached tasks wired with @oryxflow.requires. Read-and-map first, then build it up one task at a time on your confirmation. Never deletes the source; treats it as the spec.
headings: Migrate a messy data-science project into an oryxflow pipeline
1. Load the oryxflow skill first (it is the destination shape)
2. Map the source (understand before you restructure)
3. Ensure an oryxflow project to migrate INTO
4. Build the migration plan (the step -> task map)
5. Propose, then build up ONE task at a time
6. Verify against the original, then hand off

commands.name: update-project
commands.description: Bring an existing oryxflow project's scaffold floor up to date with the latest bundled template - diff the floor files (CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, viz-template.ipynb, docs skeleton) against the current template, propose a migration plan, and apply it only after the user confirms. Never touches the user's pipeline files.
